evidenceLevelCaveat: Every result in this file is a fixture-contract run: real product runtimes driven through typed view contracts in an isolated test surface. None of it is real-browser evidence; browser-labelled runs require a rendered commerce UI which does not yet exist (W1-010 pilot finding) and reuse of the W1-010 runner format.

denominator.reconciliation: planned = executed + blocked + skipped = ΣbyOutcome → 63 = 63 + 0 + 0 = 63 (zero drift)
